description: Na₅CuSO₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent S and two equivalent O atoms. All Na-S bond lengths are 3.24 Å. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.29 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent S and two equivalent O atoms. Both Na-S bond lengths are 3.02 Å. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Cu-O bond lengths are 1.81 Å. S is bonded to twelve Na atoms to form SNa₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent SNa₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent SNa₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent ONa₅Cu octahedra. O is bonded to five Na and one Cu atom to form ONa₅Cu octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONa₅Cu octahedra and faces with four equivalent SNa₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°.
